description: ThinkHuman's shared Renovate settings. Every repo's renovate.json extends this and adds only its own rules.

packageRules.description: npm package minor and patch updates (npm, pnpm, yarn or bun) arrive as one weekly PR; majors stay separate.
Payload's packages are released together and must match, so they move in their own PR.
Postgres majors come as their own PR and are never automerged: a major needs a dump and reload, not a tag bump.
prBodyNotes: **Do not merge as is.** A Postgres major cannot read the old data directory: dump the database, move to the new major on a fresh volume, and restore.

packageRules.description: Reusable workflows from ThinkHumanDotDev repos (infrastructure, .github) are pinned to a bare SHA, which the github-actions manager skips; the custom manager below tracks them.
Every pin on a ThinkHumanDotDev reusable workflow moves to that repo's latest main in one PR, reviewed by hand.

customManagers.description: Reusable workflows from ThinkHumanDotDev repos, pinned to a full SHA; follow each repo's main branch.
